FILES: rich/style.py:666
ROOT CAUSE: In `clear_meta_and_links`, the new `Style` object inherits the `_hash` of the original style (`style._hash = self._hash`), but since the new style has its `_meta` and `_link` removed, its cached hash is now incorrect.
CHANGE: Set `style._hash = None` instead of `style._hash = self._hash` in the `clear_meta_and_links` method.
TEST: tests/test_style.py
